entities.summary: Canyon Barry is an American professional basketball player who last played for the Iowa Wolves of the NBA G League. Barry also represents the United States in FIBA 3x3 basketball competition. He is the son of Lynn Norenberg Barry and Rick Barry, a Basketball Hall of Fame inductee.
